name: Delia Ramirez
stance: Calls for congressional rules, limits and oversight of AI companies, rejecting industry self-regulation.

statements.text: As AI continues to be recklessly accelerated by big tech, we are witnessing how dangerously powerful it can be without guardrails, oversight, or accountability.

Employees are sounding the alarms: Big Tech doesn't care about protecting us from AI as long as they profit. AI tools are being recklessly accelerated by big tech without guardrails, oversight, or accountability.
We cannot settle for unregulated, unaccountable AI. Congress has the obligation to demand rules and limits, pass legislation, and conduct oversight of AI companies.
You and I know that, despite what Trump and Johnson say, AI companies can’t and won’t regulate themselves.
Joined Rep. Pramila Jayapal for a shadow hearing on AI, calling for rules, limits and oversight.
We won't let diversions, rebrands, misdirection, or fake corporate "accords" confuse or deter us. We will not leave it to Trump and corporate CEOs to keep us safe - they won't and they never have.
Everyday makes it clearer: Congress can't allow AI to continue operate without guardrails, oversight, or accountability.
